summary: Bounded table getter over the low-pass cutoff string table at 0x005BE7A0. Returns a pointer to the a1-th entry (each entry is 32 bytes) when a1 is less than 4, otherwise NULL. Called by MilesSoundSampleProcessorSetup (004060C0), which indexes the four built-in low-pass filter cutoff presets.

local_names.a1: low-pass cutoff preset index (0..3); values 4 and above are rejected
local_names.result: returned table entry pointer, initialized to NULL for out-of-range indices

operations.description: Initialize the result pointer to 0 (NULL); this is the value returned for any out-of-range index
Accept the index only when a1 < 4; otherwise keep the NULL result
Compute the entry address as aLowpassCutoff + 32 * a1, treating the table as an array of 32-byte entries
Return the selected table entry for a valid index, or NULL otherwise; consumed by MilesSoundSampleProcessorSetup
